title: "A Thousand Miles": AI Rassie serenades Webb Ellis Cup after 42–38 loss
key_facts: An AI-generated clip of Springbok head coach Rassie Erasmus singing to the Webb Ellis Cup is circulating on social media in South Africa.
It was posted by the user just. fomzy.
It recreates the White Chicks scene in which Terry Crews sings Vanessa Carlton's "A Thousand Miles", with the trophy as the audience.
Briefly says the clip is entirely artificial but feels believable because Erasmus has shown his humorous side before.
It arrived soon after South Africa lost 42-38 to Australia in Perth in the Rugby Championship.
Much of the debate after the loss centered on Erasmus making 13 squad changes.
South Africa had beaten the All Blacks 3-1 in a Test series before that.
